validity.researcher_notes: The citations confirm a real 601.7 km, 1420 mm line under construction since the first weld of 20 January 2022, feeding the Ust-Luga gas processing complex. Newest dated item is an April 2025 Vedomosti article on the complex (46 percent ready in December 2024, start expected 2027 to 2030), which does not name the pipe. No citation says whether the pipe is finished. Judged only from the wiki citations.

fills.researcher_notes: Gazstroyprom news item of 20 January 2022 on the first weld of the Gryazovets-Volkhov line says the pipe diameter is 1420 mm. Read live.
